description: Token safety and security verification. Use when an agent needs a pre-buy verdict on an Ethereum token, made for IMD launches and Uniswap v4 hook tokens: no_issues_found / caution / avoid with cited reasons and the checks that could not run. Checks IMD launch match, verified source, owner powers (mint, pause, blacklist, fees, proxy), liquidity and v4 pool, holders, a buy-then-sell simulation and copycat symbols. Run by NIGHTSHIFT. Deep ($0.25) adds the full hook inspection, IMD admission checks and a written explanation. Pass the x402 payment as `payment`.

holderWallet.description: The wallet that will pay, for the holder price (50% off). Holders pay half: a paying wallet that holds 500,000+ $SHIFT (in the wallet plus staked), a NIGHT FROG or a Night Watcher gets NIGHTSHIFT house checks and reports at 50%. Fast lookup holder prices have a $0.001 minimum. Swarm Desk orders cost the full quoted price. Ask with holder=<that wallet> (MCP: holderWallet) to get the holder terms, then pay from that wallet.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload for this call's terms. Leave it out to get the terms.
